rows.grounds: compound of tri (three) and patha (path), object of declaration
past passive participle indicating completed statement
substantivized adjective naming the topic to be explained
speaker's promise to expound the next topic

items.question: What further instruction is promised after the triple path has been declared?
premises: The triple path has already been declared.
The naked remains as a topic to be explained.
The speaker addresses the listener with a promise to tell.
items.inference: After declaring the triple path, the speaker will now explain the naked to the listener.
uncertainties: The doctrinal meaning of nagnaṃ (naked) in this context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: But the triple path has been declared; now I will tell you about the naked.
